summary: GitHub resources: the Network-Automation community repo (email ansible-network@redhat.com to contribute) and the Ansible collections repos.
questions: Where can I share my network automation playbooks?

answer_card.title: Network automation GitHub repos
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Network-Automation**: an open community repo for network automation content. To contribute playbooks or roles, email ansible-network@redhat.com to be added.
- **Ansible collections**: main repos for Ansible-maintained and community collections, including network ones.

Anyone with a GitHub account can open PRs or issues.
